decisions.reason: Submarine lighting is a distant niche with long defence procurement cycles and little observable evidence, but keeping it listed costs little, so the option stays open while its value remains unresolved.
The medical examination light builds on core competences and is cheap to maintain, and with no negative evidence after several years it remains a low-cost option worth holding.
The explosion-proof line serves core industrial customers, carries sunk certification investments and has durable demand, so continued commitment is justified.
The pendant office luminaire sits close to the core and is cheap to keep, but office lighting is crowded and fast-moving in LED technology, so it faces moderate risk of replacement by newer models.
The premium pendant line is close to the established offer with several models and its own page, so its value is still unfolding and keeping it costs little relative to the premium segment it opens.
